docs-bot: Heads-up: small onboarding refresh for 'sparkkit' this sprint — focus on auth ENV clarity, single-file docker run, and modern Node/Python snippets. Splitting into tiny PRs for quick review.
mara: can you confirm the env var names? earlier docs used REDWOOD_API_HOST + REDWOOD_REGION inconsistently. prefer host+region note.
jon: I'll take docker. plan: Dockerfile + run via --env-file example. avoid docker-compose for first-run simplicity.
sophie: I'll migrate Node snippets to SDK6 and add a one-line streaming pointer. will also add Windows export examples.
netops-bot: note: Dedicated customers sometimes require X-Account-ID header; please add a short callout in "When things differ".
ci-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4625 - "sparkkit: env + links" by docs-bot
ci-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4626 - "sparkkit: Dockerfile + run" by jon
ci-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4627 - "snippets: node & python sdk6" by sophie
mara: quick UX nit: show mac/linux and windows commands for setting REDWOOD_API_KEY. add troubleshooting row for "401 after rotation".
jon: Docker run example: `docker build -t sparkkit . && docker run --env-file .env -p 3000:3000 sparkkit`. adding tests/smoke.sh to repo that retries health and a simple generate.
sophie: Node snippet (compact):
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const r = await client.generate({ model: 'clarion-mini', prompt: 'Hi' });
console.log(r.text);
```
(small error handling added in PR).
mara: reviewed PR 4625 and suggested removing hardcoded stage URL. prefer variable examples. approved.
ci-bot: PR 4625 merged at 1766123480
jon: rebased 4626, smoke passes locally. opened tiny follow-up to tweak timeout.
sophie: rebased 4627, included curl one-liner for users who don't install SDK.
ci-bot: all PRs merged; final checklist: env table, docker run, node+py snippets, Dedicated callout. closing thread.
